title: Fed Rate Hike Likely After Wireless Plan Price Surge Lifts US Core Inflation
summary: US August CPI rose 3.4% YoY and 0.4% MoM; core CPI rose 0.3% MoM, topping the 0.2% consensus. A record surge in wireless phone plan prices was the key swing factor that pushed core above forecast, effectively sealing a 25bp Fed hike at the September 15–16 FOMC meeting. Market-implied rate hike probability jumped from ~70% to ~89% following the release.
why: FOMC决策本周三（9月16日）公布，加息概率飙升至~89%；利率上升将压制所有成长股估值并推高期权隐含波动率，卖Put策略须评估strike选取；美债10年期收益率逼近5%。

title: US Hits Several Iran Oil Tankers in Response to Warship Attack; Brent Crude Surges Past $100
summary: US forces destroyed five IRGC-linked oil tankers — four in the Gulf of Oman and one near Kharg Island — in retaliation for an Iranian ballistic missile strike on a US warship. Brent crude surged 3.4% to $101.21 in a single session, later climbing toward $105. Iran simultaneously launched missiles at a US base in Jordan; Houthi rebels attacked Saudi oil facilities across four southern cities.
why: 地缘冲突推高油价至$100+并维持高位，加剧通胀压力，进一步巩固联储加息预期；能源成本上升对消费与科技板块有压制作用；同时推高标的期权隐含波动率，对卖put需谨慎。

title: Stocks Rebound Friday as Oil Pulls Back; Dow Gains 509 Points Ahead of Fed Week
summary: All three major US indexes rose on September 11 as crude oil retreated from daily highs following the release of August CPI data. The Dow closed at 52,573.29 (+0.98%), S&P 500 at 7,656.98 (+0.86%), and Nasdaq Composite at 26,333.04 (+0.96%). Markets traded higher despite the lingering backdrop of elevated oil prices and imminent Fed rate decision.
why: 大盘在CPI数据公布当日反弹，但本周迎来FOMC决策（9月16日），高油价+紧缩预期组合下市场走势分歧明显；反弹不改利率压力主线，期权卖出策略需关注周中波动放大风险。

title: Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure Revenue More Than Doubles; Sets $90B+ FY2027 Guidance
summary: Oracle Q1 FY2027 results: cloud infrastructure revenue jumped more than 100% YoY; net income rose to $4.68B ($1.56/share) from $2.93B ($1.01/share) a year ago. Management raised full-year guidance to at least $90B in revenue with non-GAAP EPS of $8.10. Capital expenditures hit $28.5B in the quarter as the company continues massive AI data center buildout.
why: Oracle云基础设施收入翻倍、$28.5B/季度资本支出证实AI算力建设需求持续爆发，利好英伟达（NVDA）GPU/Blackwell需求、SK海力士HBM及美光DRAM；为科技板块提供关键需求侧信号，对持有NVDA/Micron/SK Hynix的期权策略含义正面。

title: Apple Unveils First Foldable iPhone Duo, Starting at $1,999; Ships October 23
summary: Apple announced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, at CEO John Ternus's debut keynote on September 9. The device features a 5.4-inch outer and 7.6-inch inner display, starts at $1,999 (256GB), and will be available in Star White and Night Sky. Pre-orders open October 16; devices ship October 23 in the US and 70+ countries. Also announced: iPhone 18 Pro/Max, AirPods 5, and Apple Watch Series 12.
why: 折叠屏手机新品类正式开启；对谷歌（Pixel折叠）、三星及中国折叠机（小米18 Fold）形成直接竞争压力；Apple新产品周期带动消费电子赛道情绪与供应链（TSMC、display、内存）期待；关注发布后订单数据对科技消费板块估值的影响。

title: 腾讯控股9月11日大举回购270万股，耗资约10亿港元
summary: 财联社报道，腾讯控股（00700.HK）于2026年9月11日在港交所回购270万股，耗资约10亿港元，数据来源于港交所披露易。腾讯继续保持高频回购，当日收盘价428.400港元，上涨0.66%。
why: 腾讯股价年内下跌约26%，公司持续加大回购力度以支撑股价；每日约10亿港元的单日回购规模为期间最大，传递管理层对股价低估的强烈信号；对卖put策略而言，持续回购提供一定下行支撑，但联储加息背景下整体港股承压。

title: Trip.com Group to Report Q2 2026 Earnings on September 15; Options Imply ±5.6% Move
summary: Trip.com Group Limited (TCOM/9961.HK) will announce its Q2 and H1 2026 financial results on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 after US market close, with a conference call at 8pm ET (September 16, 8am HKT). Consensus EPS estimate is $0.98 (YoY -2.97%). Management has guided Q2 net revenue growth of approximately 3%–8% YoY. Bloomberg options data implies a ±5.6% stock move around the announcement.
why: 本周二（9月15日）盘后携程发布财报，期权隐含波动±5.6%；对持有TCOM期权仓位的投资者为高度关注事件；Q2出境游旺季数据是核心看点，若业绩不及指引上沿，隐含波动率将快速坍缩——sell put/covered call两端均需评估时间节点风险。
